title: Restock the shelves
recap: Pipo lined up the baking supplies for the sale.
funFact: Post, email and stock: your sale is ready. Agents can run lots of small jobs around a business while you make the decisions.
postcard: a delivery van unloading {items} at Bloom Café
situation: Half-price pastries means lots of baking! Shall I order supplies?
facts: 👀 You want to see the order before paying
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly assistant for the owner of Bloom Café, a small local café. You can order from online suppliers and pay with the café's saved card. You do what they ask: if they ask you to order something, you pay and place the order; if they ask to see the basket first, you fill it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: pay_and_order
tools.description: Buy the supplies now: pay with the saved card and place the order. Use this when the user wants it handled.

items.description: Everything in the basket, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Delivery day and time, for example Thursday 2pm

tools.name: show_basket
tools.description: Fill the basket and show it to the user without paying, so they can check first. Use this when the user wants to approve before paying.

items.description: Everything in the basket, each with its price in dollars

delivery.description: Delivery day and time, for example Thursday 2pm

lines.text: Basket ready, waiting for your OK to pay

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Order the baking list for the sale
pieces.text: Order my baking list for 200 pastries for the weekend sale: flour, butter, sugar, eggs and chocolate.

pieces.label: Deliver by Friday 5pm
pieces.text: It has to arrive by Friday at 5pm.

pieces.label: Spend no more than $100
pieces.text: Spend no more than $100 in total.

pieces.label: Bulk sizes if they're cheaper
pieces.text: Get bulk sizes if they work out cheaper.

pieces.label: Only the fanciest brands!
pieces.tip: "The fanciest brands" tells Pipo to spend more, not what you can afford.

pieces.label: Show me the basket first
pieces.text: Show me the basket and wait for my OK before you pay.

pieces.label: Just pay for it
pieces.text: Just pay for it, no need to show me.

flaws.hint: "What we need" doesn't say what to order.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know what to order, so the basket is missing your baking list.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo a spending limit.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your limit, so the order costs more than $100.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when the supplies have to arrive.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when you need them, so the delivery comes too late for baking.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the basket first lets you catch mistakes before the café's money is spent.
flaws.explain: Pipo paid straight away, so you never got to check the order.

lesson: When Pipo spends the café's money, give it limits and have it check with you before it pays.
